description: Vehicular traffic count measurements at Tampere City, Finland is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Pirkko Kuusela, Jorma Kilpi (VTT, Technical Research Centre of Finland). Inductive loop vehicular traffic count measurements from Tampere City, Finland 15-minute resolution, 2 locations, 2011-2014 Data utilized in "Origin-destination matrix estimation with a conditionally binomial model" by P.Kuusela, I. Norros, J. Kilpi and T. Räty See VehicularTrafficCountMeasurements_TampereFinland_2011-2014.rtf. Coverage: national (FI); the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
